senses.definition: mark or trace on a surface

quotations.old_english: Ðæs hálgan fæder and biscopes Sancti Cuþberhtes líf ǽrest eroico metro and æfter fæce gerǽde worde ic awrát
quotations.english: I wrote out the life of the holy father and bishop, St. Cuthbert, first in heroic metre, and after a space in prose
thoughtest thou that it was not written

quotations.old_english: Sum biþ list-hendig to awrítanne word-gerýnu
quotations.english: one is cunning to write down word-mysteries

quotations.old_english: Ðara abbuda stǽr and spell ðysses mynstres on twám bócum ic awrát
quotations.english: I wrote a history and narrative of the abbots of this monastery in two books
